text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent! You struck the vitals 
of every single prey with unerring 
precision.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Such flawless execution. 
You truly conducted yourself like an apex 
predator!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
If you don't mind, 
would you share your secrets with me 
later?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I feel as though your techniques, Tore-san, 
could easily be applied to hunting!
